about_app_content:
This application is a tool for wiki volunteers in Indonesia to free knowledge in their mother tongue through Wikipedia, Wiktionary, and Wikibooks.

With this app you can search for posts in wiki (Wikipedia, Wiktionary, Wikibooks), display random pages, edit existing pages, and create new pages.

For now, only Nias Wikipedia, Wiktionary, and Wikibooks are fully supported, because these three wiki sites have implemented Wikimedia's recommendation for mobile-friendly pages.

In addition, Indonesian and English Wikipedia are also supported, but Wiktionary and Wikibooks are not. For other local languages in Indonesia, improvements are still needed (implementing the aforementioned Wikimedia recommendations).

Since various wiki codes have not been made mobile-friendly according to the above recommendations, some pages may appear "strange" on the screen or even be displayed empty. An example is the Community Portal page on Indonesian Wikipedia.

Therefore, wikis in other local languages have not been activated in the application. We hope that one day the administrators of these wikis will implement the Wikimedia recommendations.

The app website is at Wikinusa website.

The application code is available at https://github.com/sslaia/wikinusa. Please contribute code for the improvement of this application there.

Some other applications I made to support free knowledge are at Nusa Apps
about_community_content:
There are many Wiki Communities in Indonesia. One of them is the Nias Wiki Community, whose members are mostly tech-illiterate and therefore need an app like this.

Some communities have only one wiki (usually Wikipedia), others have two (Wikipedia and Wiktionary), but some have three or more like Nias Wiki (Wikipedia, Wiktionary, Wikibooks).

Glad to see many wiki volunteers in the country and I provide this application to support them in contributing to free knowledge.

Click here to see various apps created to support wiki volunteers in Indonesia: Berbagai Aplikasi Nusa

My writings on community activities

  1. Nias Language Development Program 2020-2025 (Available on User:Slaia talk page in Wiktionary)
  2. Challenges of developing Nias language on Wikimedia (Available on User:Slaia talk page in Wiktionary)
  3. New Wikimedia projects main challenge and the possible solution (Available on User:Slaia talk page in Wiktionary)
  4. Proposal for the first Nias Wikipedia meeting (Available on User:Slaia talk page in Wiktionary)
  5. Preserving Nias language for whom and how (Available on User:Slaia talk page in Wiktionary)
  6. Strategy to develop Nias language in digital era (Available on User:Slaia talk page in Wiktionary)
  7. Nias Language Development Program in Three Diagrams (Available on User:Slaia talk page in Wiktionary)
  8. Strategy to develop Nias language through quality content (Available on User:Slaia talk page in Wiktionary)

Happy using Wikinusa application. Ya'ahowu!
